data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** Constructing every plugin before any start hook prevents later factories—especially the OTel factories, which now capture `Span.current()` and create spans in their constructors—from observing context installed by an earlier plugin's `onInvocationStart`. This can mis-parent or mis-sample traces. Interleave creation with startup hooks, or defer OTel context/span initialization until its start hook; update the ordering test to assert propagation.
